declare @SheetNo VARCHAR(50),@SheetSeries1 VARCHAR(50),@SheetStatus SMALLINT,@Count int,@Message VARCHAR(200),@ireturn INT 


SET @ireturn=1
SET @Message=''

declare mycursor cursor for Select SheetNo,SheetSeries, SheetStatus FROM dye.StuffWeight
where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo,@SheetSeries1,@SheetStatus
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

begin
       select @Count=COUNT(*)  FROM dye.StuffWeightDetail WHERE ISNULL(RealQty,0)>0 AND SheetSeries=@SheetSeries1
       if ISNULL(@SheetStatus,0) = 9
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='料单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已作废，不能修改!'
          End
       ELSE        
       if @Count > 0
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='料单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已经称料,不能修改！'
          End
       else
          Begin
            --允许删除时，并且删除称料表中对应数据                 
          select @ireturn=1,@Message=''
          End
   fetch next from mycursor INTO @SheetNo,@SheetSeries1,@SheetStatus
end

close mycursor	

deallocate mycursor

select @ireturn,@Message

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT SD.AddColorNum,d.StuffKindID,swp.*,c.SelfDefineImage,d.NameE,sd.ClothQtyKg 
from ( Select a.SheetSeries as PhaseSheetSeries,
a.PhaseNo as PhasePhaseNo,PhaseID,BathRatio,PH,ProgramID,
WaterQty,Remarks,PrintTimes,Temperature,Minutes,a.MachineTypeID,a.StepIndex,
b.*,CASE WHEN b.WeightUnit='K' THEN 'kg' ELSE 'g' END AS weiUnit,CASE WHEN b.RecipeUnit=0 THEN '%' ELSE 'g/l' END AS repUnit
From dye.StuffWeightPhase a
Join dye.StuffWeightDetail b On a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries 
and a.PhaseNo=b.PhaseNo)swp
left join dye.p_DyeCurve c 
on swp.ProgramID=c.CurveID
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Stuff d
ON swp.StuffID=d.StuffID
left join dye.StuffWeight SD on SD.SheetSeries=swp.SheetSeries
)p
Where 1=1 and 1=2

DECLARE  
@SheetNo VARCHAR(50),
@SheetSeries1 VARCHAR(50),
@S VARCHAR(200),
@SheetStatus SMALLINT,
@Count1 INT ,
@Count2 INT ,
@Message VARCHAR(200),
@ireturn INT 

declare mycursor cursor for Select SheetNo FROM dye.ArticleIn
where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

BEGIN
SELECT @Count1=COUNT(*) FROM dye.FAPDetail
LEFT JOIN dye.FAPMain ON FAPMain.SheetSeries = FAPDetail.SheetSeries
LEFT JOIN dye.ArticleInDetail ON ArticleInDetail.DetailNo = FAPDetail.InDetailNo
WHERE ArticleInDetail.SheetSeries=@SheetSeries AND FAPMain.SheetKind=30

SELECT 
@Count2 =COUNT(*),
@S=STRING_AGG(ArticleInDetail.DetailNo,';') 
FROM dye.ArticleOutDetail
LEFT JOIN dye.ArticleOut ON ArticleOut.SheetSeries = ArticleOutDetail.SheetSeries
LEFT JOIN dye.ArticleInDetail ON ArticleInDetail.DetailNo = ArticleOutDetail.InDetailNo
WHERE ArticleInDetail.SheetSeries=@SheetSeries 

IF  @Count1 > 0
BEGIN 
SELECT  @ireturn=0,@Message='入库单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已经转应付,不能修改！'
END 
ELSE 
IF  @Count2 > 0
BEGIN 
SELECT  @ireturn=0,@Message='明细单号【'+@S+'】已经出库,不能修改！'
END 
ELSE 
BEGIN                        
SELECT @ireturn=1,@Message=''
END 
FETCH  NEXT  FROM  mycursor INTO @SheetNo
END 

CLOSE  mycursor	

DEALLOCATE  mycursor

SELECT  @ireturn,@Message

DECLARE   
@SheetNo VARCHAR(50),
@SheetKind INT ,
@Count INT ,
@Message VARCHAR(200),
@ireturn INT 

DECLARE  mycursor CURSOR  FOR  
SELECT  SheetNo,SheetKind FROM dye.ArticleIn WHERE  SheetSeries=@SheetSeries
OPEN  mycursor
FETCH  NEXT  FROM  mycursor INTO  @SheetNo,@SheetKind

IF @SheetKind<>13
BEGIN
SELECT  @ireturn=1,@Message=''
END
ELSE BEGIN
IF (@@fetch_status <> 0)
BEGIN
DELETE dye.MaterialPriceAdjustDetail WHERE InSheetSeries=@SheetSeries

DELETE dye.MaterialPriceAdjust WHERE InSheetSeries=@SheetSeries AND SheetKind=1
                  
SELECT  @ireturn=1,@Message=''
END 
ELSE BEGIN
WHILE (@@fetch_status = 0)

BEGIN
SELECT @Count=COUNT(*) 
FROM (SELECT 
A.DetailNo AS InDetailNo,
A.ArticleID,
A.Price AS CurrentUnitPrice,
dye.fn_MaterialPriceAdjust(A.SheetSeries,B.SheetDate,B.SupplierID,A.ArticleID,1) AS LastUnitPrice
FROM dye.ArticleInDetail A
LEFT JOIN dye.ArticleIn B ON B.SheetSeries = A.SheetSeries
WHERE B.WareHouseID IN('18','19') AND A.SheetSeries=@SheetSeries
)C  WHERE 1=1 AND C.CurrentUnitPrice>C.LastUnitPrice AND C.LastUnitPrice<>0
       IF  @Count > 0
          BEGIN 
		  EXEC dye.MaterialPriceAdjustUpdate @SheetSeries,1
          SELECT  @ireturn=1,@Message='入库单号【'+@SheetNo+'】需要审核单价！'
          END 
       ELSE 
          BEGIN  
		  EXEC dye.MaterialPriceAdjustUpdate @SheetSeries,1                      
          SELECT  @ireturn=1,@Message=''
          END 
   FETCH  NEXT  FROM  mycursor INTO @SheetNo,@SheetKind
END
END
END

CLOSE  mycursor	

DEALLOCATE  mycursor

--DECLARE @SheetSeries VARCHAR(32)
--SET @SheetSeries='GC250416001'

DECLARE @SheetNo VARCHAR(32),@Count int,@Message VARCHAR(200),@ireturn INT 

SET @ireturn=1
SET @Message=''

declare mycursor cursor for Select SheetNo FROM dye.GrayStockAdjust
where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

begin
   select @Count=COUNT(*) from dye.GrayStockAdjust where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries 
   AND SheetDate<DATEADD(MONTH,-1,GETDATE())
       if @Count > 0
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='调整单号【'+@SheetNo+'】单据时间以超过一个月时间不能修改'
          End
       else
          Begin
            select @ireturn=1,@Message=''
          End
   fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo
end

close mycursor	

deallocate mycursor

select @ireturn,@Message

select gi.SheetNo,gi.SheetKind,gi.SheetDate,gi.SupplierID,gi.CustomerID,gi.SalerGroupID,gi.SalerID,
gi.WareHouseID,gi.GrayKindID,IsNull(gid.ReceSheetNo,'') as ReceSheetNo,gid.GrayID,gid.LotNo,gid.ColorID,
gid.Price,gid.StorageUnitIDs,stock.Rolls as RealRolls,Stock.LengthQty as RealLengthQty,Stock.WeightQty as RealWeightQty,
stock.Rolls as PaperRolls,Stock.LengthQty as PaperLengthQty,
stock.WeightQty as PaperWeightQty,
CONVERT(decimal(10,2),0) as  AdjustLengthQty, CONVERT(decimal(10,2),0) as  AdjustWeightQty,
CONVERT(decimal(10,2),0) as AdjustRolls  from 
(
	select ReceSheetNo,SUM(Rolls) as Rolls,SUM(LengthQty) as LengthQty,SUM(WeightQty) as WeightQty  from 
	(
	select IsNull(ReceSheetNo,'') as ReceSheetNo,IsNull(InRolls,0)-IsNull(OutRolls,0) as Rolls,
	IsNull(InLengthQty,0)-IsNull(OutLengthQty,0) as LengthQty,
	IsNull(InWeightQty,0)-IsNull(OutWeightQty,0) as WeightQty  from GrayStockBook 
	) alis
	group by ReceSheetNo
) stock
left join GrayInDetail gid on gid.ReceSheetNo=stock.ReceSheetNo
left join GrayIn gi on gi.SheetSeries=gid.SheetSeries
where 1=1 and 1=2 
order by CustomerID,GrayID,LotNo,ReceSheetNo

       else
          Begin
            select @ireturn=1,@Message=''

end

close mycursor	

deallocate mycursor

select @ireturn,@Message

Select d.StuffKindID,swp.*,d.StuffID AS StuffIDNum,d.Name AS StuffName,c.SelfDefineImage,d.NameE from ( Select a.SheetSeries as PhaseSheetSeries,
a.PhaseNo as PhasePhaseNo,PhaseID,BathRatio,PH,ProgramID,
WaterQty,Remarks,PrintTimes,Temperature,Minutes,a.MachineTypeID,a.StepIndex,
b.*,CASE WHEN b.WeightUnit='K' THEN 'kg' ELSE 'g' END AS weiUnit,CASE WHEN b.RecipeUnit=0 THEN '%' ELSE 'g/l' END AS repUnit
From dye.StuffWeightPhase a
Join dye.StuffWeightDetail b On a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries 
and a.PhaseNo=b.PhaseNo)swp
left join dye.p_DyeCurve c 
on swp.ProgramID=c.CurveID
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Stuff d
ON swp.StuffID=d.StuffID
Where 1=1 and 1=2

Select swp.*,c.SelfDefineImage,d.NameE,d.StuffID as StuffID1 from ( Select a.SheetSeries as PhaseSheetSeries,
a.PhaseNo as PhasePhaseNo,PhaseID,BathRatio,PH,ProgramID,
WaterQty,Remarks,PrintTimes,Temperature,Minutes,a.MachineTypeID,a.StepIndex,
b.*,CASE WHEN b.WeightUnit='K' THEN 'kg' ELSE 'g' END AS weiUnit,CASE WHEN b.RecipeUnit=0 THEN '%' ELSE 'g/l' END AS repUnit
From dye.StuffWeightPhase a
Join dye.StuffWeightDetail b On a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries 
and a.PhaseNo=b.PhaseNo)swp
left join dye.p_DyeCurve c 
on swp.ProgramID=c.CurveID
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Stuff d
ON swp.StuffID=d.StuffID
Where 1=1 and 1=2

SELECT * FROM dye.OrderAtte
where 1=1 and 1=2

select a.SheetSeries,isnull(SUBSTRING(a.染色要求,CHARINDEX(',',a.染色要求,1)+1,len(a.染色要求)),'') 染色要求,
                     isnull(SUBSTRING(a.包装要求,CHARINDEX(',',a.染色要求,1)+1,len(a.包装要求)),'') 包装要求,
	       isnull(SUBSTRING(a.整理要求,CHARINDEX(',',a.染色要求,1)+1,len(a.整理要求)),'') 整理要求,
                     isnull(SUBSTRING(a.质量要求,CHARINDEX(',',a.染色要求,1)+1,len(a.质量要求)),'') 质量要求,
	       isnull(SUBSTRING(a.打样要求,CHARINDEX(',',a.染色要求,1)+1,len(a.打样要求)),'') 打样要求,
		   isnull(SUBSTRING(a.另收费项目,CHARINDEX(',',a.另收费项目,1)+1,len(a.另收费项目)),'') 另收费项目,
		   isnull(SUBSTRING(a.工序,CHARINDEX('→',a.工序,1)+1,len(a.工序)),'') 工序
from (select distinct a.SheetSeries,
              染色要求=(select ','+Description FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='02'for xml path('')), 
               包装要求=(select ','+attevalue FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='00'for xml path('')),
	整理要求=(select ','+attevalue FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='03'for xml path('')),
	质量要求=(select ','+attevalue FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='04'for xml path('')),
	打样要求=(select ','+attevalue FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='09'for xml path('')),
	另收费项目=(select ','+attevalue FROM dye.OrderAtte where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries and fieldtype='05'
	and attecode not in('22072019','22072006')for xml path('')),
	工序=(select '→'+ name FROM (select a.sheetseries,c.Name from  dye.OrderProcess a join 
	(select sheetseries,min(checkno) as checkno from dye.OrderProcess group by sheetseries) b on a.CheckNo=b.checkno
     join dye.p_Process c on c.ProcessID= a.ProcessID) x where SheetSeries=a.SheetSeries for xml path(''))
from dye.OrderAtte a where a.Description is not null) a
where 1=1 and 1=2

select *   from OrderAtte  
Where  FieldType<>'05'
And 1=1 and 1=2

select *,CONVERT(bit,1) AS UnEdit from OrderAtte 
where 1=1 and 1>2

SELECT
*,
'' As Control ,
ProdID AS ProdIDCode
FROM 
(SELECT 
OrderColor.*,
b.SumAssignPacks,
b.SumAssignRolls,
b.SumAssignLengthQty,
b.SumAssignWeightQty,
c.sgdj,
d.taojia
FROM dye.OrderColor 
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT
oc.SheetSeries,
oc.CheckNo,
ISNULL(SUM(oa.Packs),0) AS  SumAssignPacks,
ISNULL(SUM(oa.Rolls),0) AS  SumAssignRolls,
ISNULL(SUM(oa.LengthQty),0) AS  SumAssignLengthQty,
ISNULL(SUM(oa.WeightQty),0) AS  SumAssignWeightQty 
FROM dye.OrderColor oc 
LEFT JOIN dye.OrderAssign oa 
ON  oa.SheetSeries=oc.SheetSeries AND  oa.CheckNo = oc.CheckNo Group by oc.SheetSeries,oc.CheckNo
) b 
ON OrderColor.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries AND
OrderColor.CheckNo=b.CheckNo
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT prodid,FeelCode,price*1000 AS sgdj FROM dye.FeelOfferDetail) c 
ON c.prodid=OrderColor.CustFabricName and c.FeelCode=OrderColor.edge
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT prodid,ColorNum,ProcessMemo AS taojia from dye.QuoteDetail) d 
ON d.prodid=OrderColor.CustFabricName and d.ColorNum=OrderColor.colornum
) a
WHERE 1=1 
AND  1=2

select * from (Select OrderColor.*,b.SumAssignPacks,b.SumAssignRolls,b.SumAssignLengthQty,b.SumAssignWeightQty 
from OrderColor

	BEGIN

	BEGIN

	   select @NUM1=COUNT(*) from dye.GrayOutDetail where ReceSheetNo=@ReceSheetNo
	   SELECT @NUM2=COUNT(*) FROM dye.GrayInDetail WHERE OriReceSheetNo=@ReceSheetNo

			  END

           else

DECLARE @JobSheetNo [varchar](50),@FabricKindID [varchar](50),@PhaseID [varchar](50),@PhaseNo [varchar](50),
	    @Dosage [decimal](10, 6), @MDosage [decimal](10, 6),@ColorLevel [varchar](50)
DELETE FROM dye.DyeProduceItem WHERE SheetSeries=@SheetSeries
CREATE TABLE #Dye
([SheetSeries] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[JobSheetNo] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[FabricKindID] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[PhaseID] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[PhaseNo] [varchar](50) NULL,
	[Dosage] [decimal](10, 6) NULL,
	[MDosage] [decimal](10, 6) NULL,
	[ColorLevel] [varchar](50) NULL)
	
INSERT INTO #Dye       
SELECT SheetSeries,JobSheetNo,FabricKindID,PhaseID,PhaseNo,Dosage,MDosage,
(CASE WHEN MDosage>=0 THEN '敏感色'
 ELSE '' END)ColorLevel 
FROM(SELECT c.SheetSeries,c.JobSheetNo,FabricKindID,b.PhaseID,b.PhaseNo,
SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.StuffType,'')='S' THEN ISNULL(Dosage,0) ELSE 0 END)Dosage,
SUM((CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.Kind,'')=2 AND ISNULL(a.StuffType,'')='S' THEN Dosage ELSE 0 END))MDosage 
FROM dye.StuffWeightDetail a
INNER JOIN dye.StuffWeightPhase b
ON a.SheetSeries = b.SheetSeries AND a.PhaseNo = b.PhaseNo
INNER JOIN dye.StuffWeight c
ON b.SheetSeries = c.SheetSeries
INNER JOIN dye.p_Stuff d
ON a.StuffID=d.StuffID
LEFT JOIN dye.p_Gray e
ON c.ProdID=e.GrayID
WHERE ISNULL(SheetKind,0)=2 AND ISNULL(RecipeType,0) IN (0,2)
AND a.SheetSeries=@SheetSeries
AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dye.p_DyeCurve f WHERE f.PhaseID=b.PhaseID)
GROUP BY c.SheetSeries,c.JobSheetNo,FabricKindID,b.PhaseID,b.PhaseNo)a

DECLARE DyeCURSOR CURSOR
	FOR
       SELECT JobSheetNo,FabricKindID,PhaseID,PhaseNo,Dosage,MDosage,ColorLevel FROM #Dye WHERE ColorLevel='敏感色' AND MDosage>0
OPEN DyeCURSOR 
FETCH NEXT FROM DyeCURSOR INTO @JobSheetNo,@FabricKindID,@PhaseID,@PhaseNo,@Dosage, @MDosage,@ColorLevel

WHILE ( @@fetch_status = 0 ) 
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO dye.DyeProduceItem
          ( SheetSeries ,JobSheetNo ,FabricKindID ,PhaseID ,PhaseNo ,Dosage ,MDosage ,ColorLevel)
  VALUES  ( @SheetSeries,@JobSheetNo,@FabricKindID,@PhaseID,@PhaseNo,@Dosage,@MDosage,@ColorLevel)
  
  FETCH NEXT FROM DyeCURSOR INTO @JobSheetNo,@FabricKindID,@PhaseID,@PhaseNo,@Dosage, @MDosage,@ColorLevel
END
